usage: 黃蜂 (wong4 fung1) is used as a noun to refer to the insect wasp.
It can be the subject or object in a sentence, e.g., 黃蜂螫人 (The wasp stings people).
When talking about wasps in general, 黃蜂 can be used with classifiers like 一隻 (jat1 zek3) meaning 'one (wasp)'.
It can describe danger or action, for example, 畀黃蜂螫咗 (got stung by a wasp).
You can use it in negative sentences, such as 我唔驚黃蜂 (I am not afraid of wasps).
